name: Promotion of Konkani Songs with Choreography & Dancing
benefit:
##### ***Cash Prizes for Performance***

- First Prize: ₹7,000/- plus memento and certificate.
- Second Prize: ₹5,000/- plus memento and certificate.
- Third Prize: ₹3,000/- plus memento and certificate.
- Special Prize for Best Choreographer: ₹2,000/- plus memento and certificate.

##### ***Traveling Allowance***

- Groups traveling up to 10 kilometers radius: ₹1,000/-.
- Groups traveling within
_eligibility_text: - The applicant must form a group consisting of 6 to 10 participants. - The applicant must submit a recording of one selected Konkani song at the time of application. - The applicant must not perform fusion of songs as it will result in automatic disqualification. - The applicant must abide by all rules and regulations of the competition organized by Tiatr Academy of Goa. - The applicant must accept that the decision of the judges will be final and binding.
